condition: Federal rule for propylene glycol: ingredient specifications and good manufacturing practice apply. Maximum levels as served vary by food category; the limit is 2% for categories not separately listed. Alcoholic beverages, confections/frostings, frozen dairy products, seasonings/flavorings and nuts have their own listed limits. The label alone does not establish this product's category or concentration.

condition: Food additive authorization withdrawn by Regulation (EU) 2022/63. The transition ended 2022-08-07; products already placed on the market could remain until their minimum durability/use-by date. Medicinal uses are a separate scope.

Territorial divergence: authorized in Great Britain; not authorized for food manufacture in Northern Ireland. Qualifying GB retail goods can have separate movement arrangements; this is not a UK-wide ban or unconditional permission.

condition: Federal food colour use: at most 1% by weight, subject to 21 CFR 73.575 and applicable standards of identity. Quantity is not supplied by the ingredient list.
Federal bromated-flour standard: at most 50 ppm in finished bromated flour, only where baking qualities improve. Other uses and state requirements need separate review.

condition: Federal food authorization is being withdrawn. Food manufacturers have until 2027-01-15 to reformulate; the ingested-drug deadline is different. This is a transition, not an unconditional permission.
